notes.title: Hang Up 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to player feedback, we’ve made updates!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33699781/9f56a5a4a5f393e93b1e20791e1b68d78964207f.png[/img]

The Shadow Factory team recently made some "Quality of Life" updates, with improvements to player controls and narrative dependent gameplay mechanics:

[list]
[*] The switchboard now inserts audio jacks on trigger release, stopping players from accidentally inserting the jack into the wrong sockets.
[*] Players should see and be able to interpret feedback from the switchboard with more clarity, with improved sound and lighting effects.
[*] As players get closer to the end of their story, they should see more dramatic gameplay mechanics, spooks, and narrative elements.
[/list]

Thanks all who have played for your overwhelming response to Hang Up, and we look forward to sharing more.
